verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm. Its client-facing tools are document-automation questionnaires, a data room and review services, not an AI agent or host application that a user could attach MCP servers to. The Legora-based generative AI assistant is described only as an internal workflow collaboration, not as a client product that accepts external tool servers, so the MCP-client axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
